summary.text: Austin Graham is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 169, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Kate Klunk.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a systems administrator and small business owner who serves on the Hanover Borough Planning Commission.

paragraphs.text: Austin Graham graduated from Middletown Area High School and earned an associate degree from YTI Career Institute in 2009.
His listed profession is system administrator, and in his 2026 Ballotpedia survey response he described a background in e-commerce, technology and operations.
He said he serves on the Hanover Borough Planning Commission and Enhancement Committee.
Graham advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
He said his campaign focuses on the cost of living, including property taxes, utilities and housing affordability, and on transparency in government.
